purpose: Select one checkpoint within each Day 12 A/B run and define the matched-budget mixture claim before observing SFT results.

required_run_invariants: same cumulative supervised-token budget at each contrast
same optimizer, scheduler, warmup, effective batch, max length and dtype
same frozen code sandbox execution protocol and complete comparison key
only the frozen Day 09 mixture manifest and resulting slice proportions may differ
invalidate_on: config drift outside the authorized mixture fields
data, tokenizer, template, scorer or protocol hash mismatch
code execution protocol or complete comparison key mismatch

sandbox_gate.forbidden_substitution: Do not treat sandbox_required, parse-only code completions, or host execution as zero-valued pass_at_1.

primary_metric.interpretation: A smaller difference is descriptive only and is inside the preregistered pilot tie band.

guardrails.comparison: candidate minus Base under the same comparison_key
guardrails.rule: A checkpoint is ineligible if any guardrail slice loses more than two correct dev cases versus Base.

steps: Eliminate ineligible checkpoints and checkpoints that fail any guardrail.
Find the maximum code correct count among remaining checkpoints.
Treat checkpoints within two code-correct cases of that maximum as the tie band.
Within the tie band, choose the checkpoint with the highest equal-weight macro accuracy over general, math and finance.
If still tied, choose the earliest cumulative supervised-token checkpoint: 25 percent, then 60 percent, then 100 percent.
within_run_selection.claim_rule: The selected checkpoint may be recorded even inside the tie band, but a meaningful target improvement claim requires at least three additional correct code cases versus Base.

matched_budget_ab_contrast.primary_statistic: paired code net wins: B-correct/A-wrong minus A-correct/B-wrong
matched_budget_ab_contrast.required_guardrail_result: both checkpoints pass all Base-relative guardrails
matched_budget_ab_contrast.claim_boundary: This is evidence for the frozen small-model pilot, data, seed and token budgets only; it is not a universal mixture claim.

uncertainty.prohibition: Do not use interval overlap or a post-hoc threshold to override the preregistered decision rule.

frozen_confirmation.when: Only after one checkpoint has been selected independently within each A/B run.
frozen_confirmation.interpretation: Report confirmation or failure descriptively; the 12-per-slice set is too small for strong population claims.
